summary: Transfer of investigation from state police to CBI; victim's allegations of ministerial kidnap/beating; delayed naming of cabinet minister as accused; sham investigation claims; failure to collect mobile CDR/CCTV evidence; High Court dismissal reversed; constitutional power to order reinvestigation affirmed (Dharam Pal, Bharati Tamang cited); State's admission of lapses under Cr.P.C. s.173(8); charges for lesser offences despite grievous hurt allegation; investigation transfer directed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; investigation transferred to CBI.
